topic: AWS Exam App — Full Project Development Strategy
chosen_direction: Sản phẩm thương mại. REST API /api/v1/ + Next.js App Router + JWT với Redis blacklist + server-side exam timer + strict 3NF PostgreSQL. Celery removed (YAGNI). difficulty field removed MVP v1.

requirements_summary.WHO: Sản phẩm thương mại nhỏ — end users ôn thi AWS certs. Single dev team.
requirements_summary.WHAT: Exam Mode (timed, scored) + Practice Mode (instant feedback). Admin import JSON. Dashboard analytics.
requirements_summary.WHEN: No hard deadline. Ship MVP first (Phases 1-6), analytics + deploy sau.
requirements_summary.WHERE: AWS EC2 + Docker. Public internet. PostgreSQL + Redis.
requirements_summary.WHY: Commercial product — cần data integrity, security, reliability cao hơn portfolio project.
requirements_summary.HOW: Full-stack parallel development. Django 5 + DRF backend. Next.js 14 App Router frontend.

api_contract_draft.auth_pattern: Bearer JWT — access 15min + refresh 7d + Redis JTI blacklist on logout

key_endpoints.description: Save partial answers — prevent state loss on refresh
Filter by cert, domain (no difficulty in MVP v1)

api_contract_draft.user_rationale: REST simple, DRF built-in support, ship fastest.

db_design_options.name: Strict 3NF PostgreSQL
db_design_options.schema_notes: Per spec. No JSONB snapshot. Referential integrity via FK. Remove difficulty field in MVP v1. Add source field to Question for future community contribution.
cons: If question edited after exam, history may inconsistent

db_design_options.name: Hybrid 3NF + JSONB snapshot
db_design_options.schema_notes: exam_attempts.snapshot JSONB stores full question state at time of exam
pros: Question edits don't affect old results

risk_matrix.risk: Exam state lost on page refresh (no autosave)
risk_matrix.mitigation: PATCH /api/v1/exam/{id}/autosave + localStorage sync every 30s. Implement before Exam Mode ships.

risk_matrix.risk: is_correct exposed in exam API response → trivial cheating
risk_matrix.mitigation: Separate ExamSerializer (no is_correct/explanation) vs AdminSerializer. Mandatory test coverage for this.

risk_matrix.risk: JWT not revocable — logout doesn't work truly
risk_matrix.mitigation: Store JTI in Redis blacklist on logout. TTL = token expiry. Access token 15min only.
Docker restart:always + RDS managed Postgres + Sentry error tracking + /api/v1/health/ endpoint.

risk_matrix.risk: Exam timer client-only → cheatable via DevTools
risk_matrix.mitigation: Store started_at + time_limit_minutes in ExamAttempt. Backend validates on submit: reject if past deadline.

security: JWT no blacklist — logout not truly enforced → MITIGATED: Redis JTI blacklist
is_correct exposed in API → MITIGATED: separate serializers
Admin JSON import lacks validation → Add JSON schema validation + HTML sanitize
devops: Single EC2 SPOF → restart:always + RDS + Sentry
Exam timer client-only → MITIGATED: server-side validation
end_user: Exam state loss on refresh → MITIGATED: autosave
Empty state onboarding missing → Add onboarding flow (pick certification)
Question navigation needs status grid → answered/unanswered/flagged colors like AWS real exam
yagni: AI Explanation (section 12.3) → skip MVP v1, explanation already in Answer.explanation
Celery → removed, Redis for caching+blacklist only
difficulty field → removed MVP v1, add later when analytics need it
competitor: Add to Practice List from Review screen → high value, low effort
Question.source field for future community contribution → add now (cheap)
Optional timer in Practice Mode → nice-to-have v2

contradictions_resolved.conflict: difficulty field — competitor says common, YAGNI says skip
contradictions_resolved.resolution: User chose YAGNI — remove from MVP v1
contradictions_resolved.rationale: No filter/analytics feature using it yet

acceptance_criteria: Exam Mode: 65 questions, 130min timer enforced server-side
Exam Mode: autosave every 30s — state survives refresh
Practice Mode: instant feedback after each answer
API: is_correct never exposed outside admin endpoints
Auth: logout invalidates token via Redis blacklist
Admin: JSON import with schema validation
Docker: all services start with docker-compose up
architecture_decisions: JWT: short-lived access (15m) + refresh (7d) + Redis JTI blacklist
Exam timer: started_at + time_limit_minutes stored in ExamAttempt, validated on submit
Serializer strategy: separate ExamSerializer (safe) vs AdminSerializer (full)
No Celery: Redis used for caching + JWT blacklist only
No difficulty field in MVP v1
Question.source field added for future extensibility
Next.js App Router (not React SPA) for SEO + SSR
test_strategy: Unit tests for serializer field exclusion (is_correct). Integration test for timer validation. E2E test for exam submit flow. Auth blacklist test.
